title: Popup boxes — the rule applied, and buttons in popups with several boxes

steps.path: Rename session · Pick a handle · Settings → Assistant → Cloud → Connect OpenRouter
steps.headline: The buttons moved inside the box in Rename session, Pick a handle and Connect OpenRouter.
steps.changed: Each popup is now one box holding its words, field and buttons (your pick on the last page).
steps.notice: One less layer: nothing sits loose under the box any more.
steps.risk: These three don't fully mirror each other yet (item 4); that comes next on its own page.

steps.path: Picking Skip permissions or a small model the first time · Settings → Assistant → Permissions → Skip permissions
steps.headline: Buttons inside the box, and the "Tick the box to continue" line is gone.
steps.changed: The line under the tick box is removed. Point at the grey button and a hint says "Tick the box to continue". Skip permissions' own confirm got the same hint.
steps.notice: The hint appears after resting the pointer on the grey button for under a second; on a touchscreen, press and hold it.
steps.risk: Someone on a phone who never presses and holds won't see the hint; the tick box sits right above the button.

steps.path: Projects → remove a project (a folder; a synced one) · turn on sync for a folder
steps.headline: Remove project and Turn on sync: buttons inside the box.
steps.changed: Same words and buttons, now inside the one box. A missing folder's plain two-sentence Remove stays plain text, as before.
steps.notice: The buttons now read as part of the same decision as the words above them.

steps.path: Model picker → Fast mode · Resuming an older conversation that needs a model picked
steps.headline: Fast mode's buttons sit inside its box; the resume popup lost the extra box around the model picker.
steps.changed: Resume: the picker and its buttons now share one box instead of the picker alone being boxed (you asked for that box to go).
steps.risk: Fast mode is still "a bit weird" otherwise; it gets its own redesign with item 4.
steps.notice: Both popups are one layer shallower.

steps.path: Games → a friend → details · Appearance → a theme you built → share
steps.headline: Friend details and Publish theme: actions inside the box.
steps.changed: Unfriend and Block now sit in the friend's own box; Publish sits in the box that explains publishing. The theme's picture stays outside, as a picture of the item.
steps.notice: The friend's actions read as being about that friend.

steps.path: Settings → Appearance → (i) · Backup & sync → What is this? (all six (i) pages)
steps.headline: Every (i) page now labels its first box "Overview".
steps.changed: The opening box has the label you picked; the boxes after it are unchanged.
steps.notice: Every box on an (i) page now has a label, so none looks filed under nothing.

steps.path: Close session, Update, Submit a ticket, Session details, Settings popups
steps.headline: In a popup with several labelled boxes, where should buttons that act on the whole popup go?
steps.today: It varies. Close session and Update pin their buttons to a line at the very bottom of the popup that stays put while the boxes scroll. Submit a ticket puts them under the last box, so they scroll with it. Popups whose boxes each have their own buttons (Settings) have none for the whole popup.
steps.problem: Two looks for the same thing; on a long popup the scrolling kind can sit out of sight until you scroll down.
steps.proposal: Pick one shape for every popup with several boxes. It only affects buttons that act on the whole popup (Close session, Send, Update), not a box's own buttons.

options.label: Pinned bottom line
pros: Always in view, however long the popup
Already how Close session and Update work
Clearly about the whole popup, not one box
cons: Takes a strip of height from the scrolling part

options.label: Under the last box
pros: Reads top to bottom: fill in, then act
cons: Scrolls out of sight on long popups

options.label: Inside the last box
pros: Matches the one-job rule (buttons inside a box)
cons: Reads as belonging to that box only, not the whole popup
